title: A cloud run can land twice, and the agent reaches for a paid model unprompted
description: Two cloud-safety bugs found live on 2026-09-21. (1) One DeepInfra call returned two copies of one image and became two gallery cards; the route must honour the count it asked for. (2) Cloud models carry no rank and no note, so the in-app agent picked a billed model for a plain t2i. Brief: brief.md.
